title: iTransformer: Variate-token transformers show positive transfer across domains on ETTh1, Traffic, Exchange
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using iTransformer, a inverted transformer treating variates as tokens. On ETTh1, Traffic, Exchange, at horizon 336, Variate-token transformers show positive transfer across domains on ETTh1, Traffic, Exchange. iTransformer pretrained on Electricity yields a 17% MSE reduction over random init when fine-tuned on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity. Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.
